calls.title: Elyse Fox and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the strategic role of product marketing, led by Ashley Stirrup, highlighting the importance of soft metrics and long-term growth indicators over immediate outputs. Key metrics for success include average selling price (ASP) growth and overall pipeline health. The team will prioritize customer-centric content that addresses pain points and trends, rather than deep technical research. Collaboration and flexibility are key themes, with an emphasis on empowering team members and allowing for asynchronous work. E expressed alignment with this strategic approach, committing to developing a one-year plan to outline priorities and demonstrate the role's value in the company's growth. The meeting concluded with a vision for gradually scaling the product marketing function as the company grows.
calls.keywords: Product Marketing, A/B Testing, GrowthBook, Feature Flags, Thought Leadership, Team Collaboration
calls.action_items:
**Elyse Fox**
Prepare and send a draft seven-slide one-year product marketing plan including approach, early priorities, onboarding strategy, and quick wins (27:51)
Schedule and conduct formal presentation of the plan on Wednesday at 12:30 PM Pacific Time with key stakeholders (28:23)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Send calendar invite for the Wednesday presentation and confirm attendees from prior interview panel (29:02)
Provide feedback on Elyse’s draft plan after submission to ensure alignment on role expectations and company priorities (23:07)
